configurations.name: club
configurations.description: Difficulty level: depth 6, the full evaluation, may pick a move within 0.00 pawns of its best.

what: The difficulty levels against each other: twelve openings, each played twice with colours swapped. Novice, Casual and Club search to their own fixed depth with no clock. Expert had 1000 ms per move, a third of its real allowance.
